BURSEVI:v6p220#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p220#2/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p220#2/r3.claim: They must complete the measure and not shortchange people's rights; خسرته and أخسرته mean that one made another's due deficient.
BURSEVI:v6p220#2/r3.anchor: {ولا تكونوا من المخسرين} حقوق الناس بالتطفيف

IBNABIHATIM:v9p2811#3/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2811#3/r1.speaker: سعيد بن المسيب
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2811#3/r1.claim: Do not hurry to leave a land where people give full measure, but leave quickly if they cheat.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2811#3/r1.anchor: عن يحيى بن سعيد قال : كان سعيد بن المسيب يقول : اذا كنت بارض يوفون المكيال والميزان فلا تعجل بالخروج منها ، واذا كنت بارض لا يوفون المكيال والميزان فعجل بالخروج منها .

IBNABIHATIM:v9p2811#3/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2811#3/r2.speaker: خلف بن حوشب
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2811#3/r2.claim: Shuayb's people were destroyed for shaving off tiny amounts, taking with a heavy measure and giving with a light one.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2811#3/r2.anchor: عن خلف بن حوشب قال : هلك قوم شعيب من شعيرة إلى شعيرة كانوا ياخذون بالرزينة ويعطون بالخفيفة .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r1.claim: Shuaib shifts from the general call to worship into detailed rules for dealings: his people shirked, cheated in measures and weights, undervalued goods, and spread corruption.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r1.anchor: الدعوة التفصيلية بوضع قوانين المعاملة بينهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r2.claim: Short measure and weight are oppression and illicit consumption; their merchants colluded in it, forcing buyers into such transactions.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r2.anchor: فأما تطفيف الكيل والميزان فظلم وأكل مال بالباطل

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r3.claim: أوفوا commands making the measure complete, with no shortfall.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r3.anchor: أمر بالإيفاء ، أي جعل الشيء وافيا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r4.claim: المخسر is one who causes another a loss, hence a short-measurer; saying not to be among them more forcefully disowns their practice, like the wording in Noah's story.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v19p184#2/r4.anchor: لأنه يدل على الأمر بالتبرؤ من أهل هذا الصنيع

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p241#2/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p241#2/r9.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p241#2/r9.claim: Beyond disbelief, their named offense was cheating the scales and diminishing people's property.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p241#2/r9.anchor: وكانت معصيتهم المضافة إلى كفرهم بخس الموازين وتنقص أموال الناس بذلك

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p142/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p142/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p142/r1.claim: Mukhsirīn are those who reduce measures or weights; akhsartu the measure means you made it deficient.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p142/r1.anchor: من الناقصين للكيل يقال أخسرت الكيل والوزن إذا نقصته

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p159/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p159/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p159/r1.claim: They must give buyers a complete measure, neither short-changing them nor taking less than the full measure when they buy; give as they take.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p159/r1.anchor: ولكن خذوا كما تعطون، وأعطوا كما تأخذون

JISHUMI:v7p5383/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5383/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5383/r4.claim: Iyfāʾ means giving the full due without shortfall; a mukhsir causes a loss by reducing capital, the opposite of increasing it.
JISHUMI:v7p5383/r4.anchor: الإيفاء: إعطاء الواجب بكماله من غير نقصان، أوفى يوفي إيفاء

JISHUMI:v7p5383/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5383/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5383/r5.claim: Qisṭās is just measurement by volume; its association with Greek is rejected because the Qur'an is Arabic, so the word is either Arabized or shared across languages.
JISHUMI:v7p5383/r5.anchor: والقسطاس: العدل في التقويم على المقدار

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p337/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p337/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p337/r1.claim: Measure may be complete, deficient, or excessive: full measure is required and shortchanging forbidden; silence about excess implies it is good but not required.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p337/r1.anchor: الكيل على ثلاثة أضرب : واف ، وطفيف ، وزائد . فأمر بالواجب الذي هو الإيفاء

MUQATIL:26:181-186/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:26:181-186/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:26:181-186/r1.claim: Shuaib orders full measure and a straight scale—qistas is the Roman word for balance—and forbids cheating people of rights or spreading corruption through sins.
MUQATIL:26:181-186/r1.anchor: يعنى بالميزان المستقيم، والميزان بلغة الروم القسطاس،

NASAFI-FULL:v3p196#10/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p196#10/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p196#10/r1.claim: Complete the measure and do not deprive people of their rights: full measure is commanded, short measure forbidden, and excess is unaddressed and therefore commendable if given but not required.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p196#10/r1.anchor: ﴿ أوفوا الكيل ﴾ أتموه ﴿ ولا تكونوا من المخسرين ﴾ ولا تنقصوا الناس حقوقهم فالكيل واف

QURTUBI-FULL:26:181-184/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:181-184/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:181-184/r1.claim: The messengers share the same answer because they all command piety, obedience, exclusive worship, and refusal to demand payment for delivering the message.
QURTUBI-FULL:26:181-184/r1.anchor: لأنهم متفقون على الأمر بالتقوى، والطاعة والإخلاص في العبادة

QURTUBI-FULL:26:181-184/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:26:181-184/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:26:181-184/r2.claim: Complete the measure and do not reduce what is measured or weighed; weigh with justice and give people their due.

STUDYQURAN:26:181/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:181/r1.speaker: Ṭ, Th
STUDYQURAN:26:181/r1.claim: These verses prohibit cheating in buying and selling.
STUDYQURAN:26:181/r1.anchor: These verses instruct people not to cheat in matters of buying and selling (Ṭ, Th)

STUDYQURAN:26:181/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:26:181/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:26:181/r3.claim: The Midianites were guilty of corrupt, predatory commercial practices, discussed at 7:85 and 11:84–86.
STUDYQURAN:26:181/r3.anchor: On the corrupt and predatory mercantile practices of which the Midianites were guilty, see 7:85c; 11:84–86c.

TAB-FULL:v17p634#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v17p634#2/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v17p634#2/r2.claim: He commands them to give people their full measure and not be among those who reduce others' due.
TAB-FULL:v17p634#2/r2.anchor: الكيل. {ولا تكونوا من المخسرين} [الشعراء: 181] يقول: ولا تكونوا ممن نقصهم حقوقهم

TABATABAI:26:176-177/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:26:176-177/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:26:176-177/r3.claim: Measure determines goods by volume and must be full; the straight qistās is a scale for weight and must be used justly, requiring fairness in giving and receiving.
TABATABAI:26:176-177/r3.anchor: الكيل ما يقدر به المتاع من جهة حجمه وإيفاؤه أن لا ينقص الحجم، والقسطاس الميزان الذي يقدر به من جهة وزنه واستقامته أن يزن بالعدل

TABRISI:26:176-184/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:26:176-184/r5.speaker: author
TABRISI:26:176-184/r5.claim: Mukhsir describes someone causing a loss in capital by short measure; its opposite is making a profit.
TABRISI:26:176-184/r5.anchor: المخسر المعرض للخسران في رأس المال بالنقصان أخسر يخسر إخسارا

TABRISI:26:176-184/r11.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:26:176-184/r11.speaker: author
TABRISI:26:176-184/r11.claim: Give full measure means no shortfall, extending to measure, weight, length, and counting; do not be among those who reduce measures or weights.
TABRISI:26:176-184/r11.anchor: أعطوا الكيل وافيا غير ناقص ويدخل الوفاء في الكيل والوزن والذرع والعدد

THALABI:v7p178/r5.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v7p178/r5.speaker: author
THALABI:v7p178/r5.claim: أوفوا الكيل means give full measure and do not reduce people’s measures or weights.
THALABI:v7p178/r5.anchor: أوفوا الكيل ولا تكونوا من المخسرين الناقصين للكيل والوزن

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p119/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p119/r1.speaker: المفسرون
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p119/r1.claim: The loss-makers are those who reduce the measure or weight.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p119/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p119/r2.speaker: أبو عبيد
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p119/r2.claim: Abū ʿUbayd explains both khasartu and akhsartu the scale as reducing it.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p119/r2.anchor: أبو عبيد: يقال: خسرت الميزان، وأخسرته، نقصته

WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p119/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p119/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p119/r3.claim: The phrase about those who give short measure in al-Muṭaffifīn has the same sense, and yukhsirūn is also linguistically allowed.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v17p119/r3.anchor: قوله تعالى: {وإذا كالوهم أو وزنوهم يخسرون} [المطففين: 3] (¬5) أي: ينقصون في الكيل والوزن

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:26:181/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:26:181/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:26:181/r1.claim: Give full measure and do not be among those who reduce people’s measure or weight.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:26:181/r1.anchor: أوفوا الكيل } أتموه { ولا تكونوا من المخسرين

YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p521/r4.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p521/r4.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v2p521/r4.claim: Giving full measure means not reducing people’s rights; al-Suddi also says not to reduce measure or weight.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p443/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p443/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p443/r1.claim: The section recounts Shu‘ayb and the people of Madyan: as Lot warned about moral misconduct, Shu‘ayb warned about economic misconduct; they persisted and met the other nations' fate, and the account closes with repeated verses.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p443/r1.anchor: Just as Lot (sws) warned his nation of their moral misconduct, Shu‘ayb (sws) warned his nation of economic misconduct.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r5.claim: Madyan's people were accomplished traders, but indifference to God and the Hereafter let Satan turn their trade toward cheating in weights.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r5.anchor: The people of Madyan were traders by profession and had advanced to great heights in it.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r6.claim: Fraudulent weighing is a contagious economic disease that pulls traders and businesses into wider deception and exploitation.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r6.anchor: This economic misconduct is a severe disease that is contagious.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r7.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r7.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r7.claim: God made the world depend on balance; it guides people to uphold justice throughout society and the economy, whose balance can otherwise collapse.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-5-english:p444/r7.anchor: The Almighty has created this world with a balance and the heavens and the earth remain intact because of this balance.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p186/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p186/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p186/r5.claim: Full measure is obligatory and short measure is fraud; generosity above the required amount is commendable but leaving it is not blameworthy.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p186/r5.anchor: أمرهم بإيفاء الكيل، وهو الواجب، ونهاهم عن الإخسار، وهو التطفيف

ALUSI-FULL:v19p118#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p118#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p118#2/r1.claim: Being among those who cause loss means shortchanging people's rights through deficient measures.

ALUSI-FULL:v19p118#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p118#2/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p118#2/r2.claim: The emphatic construction may intensify the prohibition; alternatively, as with the prohibition on doubled usury, no restrictive implication is drawn. Either way it reinforces the prior command.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p118#2/r2.anchor: ولعل المبالغة المستفاد من التركيب متوجهة إلى النهي

ALUSI-FULL:v19p118#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v19p118#2/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v19p118#2/r3.claim: The following order to weigh concerns goods measured by weight.
ALUSI-FULL:v19p118#2/r3.anchor: المذكور تأكيد للامر السابق عليه ( وزنوا ( الموزونات

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p127/r9.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p127/r9.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p127/r9.claim: Those who reduce measures and weights diminish people's rights.

BAYDAWI-FULL:26:181-186/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:181-186/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:181-186/r1.claim: Give full measure and do not diminish people's rights by short measure.
BAYDAWI-FULL:26:181-186/r1.anchor: { أوفوا الكيل } أتموه. { ولا تكونوا من المخسرين } الناقصين حقوق الناس بالتطفيف.

BIQAI-FULL:v5p387/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p387/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p387/r1.claim: The root problem is greed for money; sellers must fully measure for customers just as they expect full measure for themselves.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p387/r1.anchor: إذا كلتم كما توفونه إذا اكتلتم لأنفسكم

BIQAI-FULL:v5p387/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p387/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p387/r2.claim: Do not become a settled class of short-changers: cheating others impoverishes one's own religion, though passing impulses can be resisted and erased.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p387/r2.anchor: أي كونا هو كالجبلة , ولعله إشارة إلى ما يعرض من نحو ذلك من الخواطر
